scope.scopeLimit: One inspected held-phase capture in the H64/980x620/DPR1 viewport. This does not establish full-lifetime behavior or results at other viewports.
scope.finding: The top of the clock sphere and the upper star are clipped beyond the canvas in the inspected image. The visible placement is consistent with the shader geometry; R6 at the same viewport retained top margin. This scoped view is not accepted for visual quality. The clock shell, dial/hands, sparkles and pale character light band are also visible.
scope.evidenceLimits: The capture contains 130 sample records across about 12.9 seconds, while the effect lifetime is 5000 ms. Samples include loop indices 0–2 and all four phases. Per-sample records are not independent GPU-completion receipts, and the image is not bound to an exact receipt frame. Do not infer complete lifetime acceptance.

comparedAgainst.result: same-viewport R6 showed top margin; no quantitative quality comparison claimed.
